frequency_question: How often do countries successfully sign a successor water treaty before or upon the expiration of a long-term water-sharing agreement?
membership_rule: Includes formal bilateral transboundary water treaties expiring after a multi-decade term where renewal or replacement was formally negotiated by the riparian states. Excludes domestic water pacts and non-treaty informal understandings.
window: Within a 5-year window leading up to or immediately following the expiration of the prior agreement.

cases.name: Indus Waters Treaty implementation and adjustments
Colorado River Basin Salinity Agreement renewals
1996 Ganga Water Treaty initial signing window
Lesotho Highlands Water Project phase protocols

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 named major benchmark cases; representing standard state practice for major transboundary river basins.
known_gaps: Limited strictly to major inter-state treaties with high geopolitical visibility, omitting minor local agreements.
skeleton: 5 historical transboundary water treaty renewal/successor milestones examined across major international basins.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 comparable major historical water treaty renewal instances where a formal framework was sought.
validity_reason: State norms regarding international water treaties and diplomatic continuity change slowly over decades.
